evidence.title: HE Saeed Mohammed Al Tayer reviews construction progress at Moro Hub's new Green Data Centre in Warsan
evidence.excerpt: Moro Hub's January 23 disclosure reports ongoing construction of the first phase of its new Green Data Centre in Warsan and forecasts the first phase to launch in the second half of 2026.
